panels.label: Genuine internal help
panels.specimen: Card "Administrator help", SECONDARY "Open email app", neutral outline row "Administrator guide". Cyan BOARD note "Proposed genuine actions / settings placeholders today". No raw URL/email, Bug report submitted, copied/sent toast, live contact or guaranteed guide availability.

panels.label: Administrative legal reference
panels.specimen: Card "Legal reference", two document rows "Terms and conditions" and "Privacy policy". Cyan BOARD note "Confirm authoritative documents and version". No real legal clauses/date, compliance/encryption/sharing guarantee, accepted consent, fabricated external destination or legal-signoff badge.

support_contract: Distinguish self-service FAQ, automated assistance, OS contact handoff, clipboard copy, server support ticket and admin case management; labels must match performed action.
Use documented configured contact sources, reconcile hardcoded conflicts and avoid sample endpoints. Configured is not verified reachable or staffed.
Phone/email app opening is not connection, sending, receipt or resolution. Check false returns and exceptions; provide readable recoverable failure.
Clipboard confirmation only after successful awaited write. Copy is not a phone/email launcher or contact event.
Keep search/filter/expand behavior functional or clearly proposed; missing FAQ matches are not support unavailability.
No fake ticket, bug report, live-agent availability, operating-hour/SLA, refund/settlement/fee or legal assurance from a static card.

Support requests use server identity/current owner and action payload; preserve idempotency and distinguish unchanged retry versus edited new request. Widget-lifetime IDs are not durable offline queues.
After upload/submit/read/confirmation, current account/session/entity/route ownership must still hold. Sensitive attachments are optional; removal UI does not certify deletion or secure storage.
Rider Submitted/Seen/Closed differs from administrative Open/In progress/Waiting/Resolved; workflow closure is not business settlement.
Routine help and emergency/safety actions remain separate. Dialer handoff does not notify support, share location or dispatch emergency help.

Policy entries require authoritative approved content/source/version; do not invent effective dates, consent state, compliance or blanket privacy guarantees. Internal versus external destination icons must reflect supported route.
Proposed legal entries for Delivery/Associate require confirmed destination; Admin settings placeholder help actions need real implementation. Do not clone every support feature across apps.

Readable headings, labelled external handoffs, target sizes, focus/announcements, text scaling and dark contrast require later runtime checks. Raster boards are target specimens, not certified live services.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
limits: Raster proposals; no runtime/accessibility certification or pixel-exact color/geometry claim.
